underrail_builder_remake.usage_note: Reference only; source is linked and attributed but not vendored or copied wholesale. This catalog re-expresses selected public game computation rules in this project's own normalized JSON shape.

notes: The save editor treats budgets as editable targets because unspent point counters are not fully mapped.
The cap and budget formulas are used for validation/preview only; clone-first writes still preserve source saves.

skill_effective_formula.synergy_component: sum floor(source_allocated_points * synergy_percent / 100), then reduce synergy points that would push base_component + synergies over skill_cap(level)
skill_effective_formula.save_editor_scope: Preview/audit only. The current writer preserves the loaded effective-minus-allocated delta instead of recomputing every bonus source.

notable_modifiers: Juggernaut and equipment can add or multiply health

Psi Pool.base_formula: 100 before feats/equipment, only meaningful with Psi Empathy
notable_modifiers: Expanded Psi Capacitance increases reserve/pool related values
Neurology and gear can add flat psi
Mantra and tattoos can add regeneration
Expanded Psi Capacitance can multiply reserve

Psi Slots.base_formula: min(2 + floor(slot_attribute / 2), 8), where slot_attribute is normally Intelligence or Will with Forceful Innervation

notable_modifiers: Strider, tattoos, and equipment can add movement points
Paranoia, Gunslinger, Trigger Happy, and equipment can add initiative

Fortitude.base_formula: (8 + 4 * level) scaled by a weighted Constitution/Strength/Will modifier
notable_modifiers: Thick Skull specialization and equipment can add fortitude
Iron Will, Body Horror, Philosophy feats, tattoos, and equipment can modify resolve
Paranoia, Fine Tuned, tattoos, and equipment can modify detection

Trap Detection.base_formula: max(floor(0.75 * detection), floor(0.50 * detection + 0.75 * effective Traps))

notable_modifiers: Pack Rathound, Beast of Burden, specialization, and equipment can add carry weight

builder_reference_inventory.integration_note: Only compact, factual summaries and formulas are represented here. Full feat predicates/specializations should be independently normalized from wiki text and save fixtures before becoming write-gating logic.
